personal.name: Hari Bashyal
personal.tagline: I build websites and web apps, and I set up automation so businesses spend less time on repeated work.
personal.availability: Open to full-time, contract, and remote roles

about.short: I'm a full-stack developer. I build websites and web apps using React and Node.js, and I connect them to databases like MySQL. I also build automations with n8n and do SEO work, so what I build actually works well and gets found on Google.
about.long: I finished my BSc in Computer Science and IT. I started as an intern, building a hospital management system from scratch. Now I work full-time doing web development, automation, and SEO at a media and marketing company. I can handle a full feature on my own — from the database to the part people actually click on. I write code that's easy for the next developer to read, and I like explaining things in plain language, not jargon.

projects.name: Hospital Management System
projects.problem: The hospital was doing patient registration, appointments, and billing by hand on paper. This caused mistakes and wasted everyone's time.
outcomes: Built separate sections for reception, doctors, pharmacy, and admin staff
Made patient check-in about 60% faster with a simple, clear screen
Designed the database for patients, appointments, prescriptions, and bills
Added login security and activity logs for sensitive actions

projects.name: CryptoCloudNews
projects.problem: The client wanted one clean page that shows live crypto prices, news, and upcoming events, instead of jumping between different sites.
outcomes: Built a live dashboard showing prices for major coins like Bitcoin and Ethereum
Added a live news feed and an events section with countdown timers
Kept the whole site fast and easy to read, even with a lot of live data on screen

projects.name: Vaidhya Herbals — E-commerce Website
projects.problem: Vaidhya Herbals sells herbal products from Nepal, but had no way to sell online — customers could only buy in person.
outcomes: Built the full online shop — product pages, cart, and checkout
Made it work well on both phone and desktop
Set up a simple product catalog that's easy for the owner to update

projects.name: MiChe Auto Nepal — AI Chatbot
projects.problem: Customers had a lot of questions about bikes, prices, and orders, and the sales team couldn't answer everyone fast enough.
outcomes: Built an AI chatbot that answers customer questions about products and pricing
Connected the chatbot directly to the website
Helped the team respond to customers faster

projects.name: Marketing Automation Suite (n8n)
projects.problem: The marketing team spent hours every day manually moving leads between tools, sending follow-up emails, and building reports.
outcomes: Built more than 10 automated workflows in n8n to handle leads, update the CRM, and send follow-ups
Cut manual reporting work by about 8 hours a week
Set up an alert that messages the team on WhatsApp the moment something breaks
Wrote simple guides so non-developers can safely update the automations

projects.name: SEO & GEO Optimization
projects.problem: Client websites worked fine, but Google and AI tools like ChatGPT and Perplexity weren't finding or showing them.
outcomes: Added structured data (schema) so Google understands the pages better
Rewrote content so AI search tools can pull direct answers from it
Grew organic traffic by a double-digit percentage within 90 days
Made a simple SEO checklist the whole content team now uses

outcomes: Loads fast, even on slower phone internet
Looks right on any screen — phone, tablet, or laptop
Easy to read, with good color contrast and keyboard navigation
All content comes from one file, so I can update it in minutes

elevatorPitch: I'm Hari Bashyal, a full-stack developer from Nepal. I build websites and apps with React and Node.js, automate repetitive work with n8n so businesses save time, and make sure the sites I build actually show up on Google. I've shipped a hospital management system into production, built automations that save teams 30+ hours a week, and I'm looking for a role where I can own real features from database to deployment.
